title: The Old Bull
text: A huge old bull blocks the trail, broad as a wagon, its hide a map of scars from every hunter who tried for it. Broken spearheads are still lodged in its hump. It looks at the bravest of you, and only them, as if it knows.

options.label: The bravest stands their ground before it, since it is them it has chosen.

outcomes.text: It snorts, long and hot, and steps aside for them alone. They do not breathe until it has passed.
It charges anyway, and the scars on its hide get a new story.

options.label: Bring the old bull down where every hunter before you failed.

outcomes.text: It does not go down easily, and it does not go down alone, but it goes down. Its horns are worth a purse.

options.label: Go the long way round. That bull has outlived better hunters than you.

outcomes.text: A day lost to the brambles, and the bull's eyes on your backs the whole first hour.
